Location / asset content: Mapped facilities, water/sewer works, power networks and telecom features; point, line and polygon geometry.
Access / format: Bulk OSM PBF; regional extracts normally daily. Use full PBF for custom infrastructure filters.
License / permission: ODbL 1.0; attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.
Vintage / update notes: Extract publication is not the date each asset was surveyed.
Main limitation: Uneven completeness and tagging. Preserve OSM type + ID and lifecycle tags; do not infer absence from missing records.

Location / asset content: Standardized infrastructure features including power lines and communication towers; multiple geometry types.
Access / format: Cloud-native GeoParquet; versioned releases.
License / permission: Base theme: ODbL. Preserve source attribution.
Vintage / update notes: Pin a specific release and schema version.
Main limitation: Infrastructure is OSM-derived; not independent corroboration of OSM. Does not retain every possible OSM attribute.

Location / asset content: Hospital and other healthcare destination points, names, taxonomy, addresses and source metadata.
Access / format: GeoParquet from cloud sources; monthly release cadence.
License / permission: CDLA Permissive 2.0 and Apache 2.0, depending on source; inspect attribution.
Vintage / update notes: Documentation reviewed describes September 2026 data and current taxonomy.
Main limitation: Place existence confidence is not coordinate accuracy or clinical capability. Places is separate from the OSM-derived Base theme.

Source / product: Global Energy Monitor — Global Integrated Power Tracker
Location / asset content: Geolocated generation units/projects; fuel, capacity, status, ownership and location-accuracy information.
Access / format: Download via GEM tracker page / download form.
License / permission: CC BY 4.0; check download-specific terms.
Vintage / update notes: Tracker page identifies September 2026 release.
Main limitation: Technology-specific minimum capacity thresholds. Includes non-operating projects and approximate coordinates; retain unit-to-site hierarchy.

Location / asset content: Plant point coordinates, fuel, capacity, ownership, generation and source references.
Access / format: CSV; WRI repository and data portal.
License / permission: CC BY 4.0 for data; code license is separate.
Vintage / update notes: Repository states unmaintained, latest release v1.3.0; no planned updates as of early 2022.
Main limitation: Historical crosswalk / gap-filling only. A newer portal metadata timestamp does not establish a refreshed inventory.

Source / product: World Bank / ESMAP — ENERGYDATA.INFO grid datasets
Coverage: Multiple countries; particularly useful for country-level grid work
Location / asset content: Transmission and distribution lines and, for some datasets, substations.
Access / format: Catalog; dataset-specific GeoJSON, Shapefile, other vector files and services.
License / permission: Dataset-specific; verify each resource.
Vintage / update notes: Survey dates, source-map dates and publication dates vary.
Main limitation: Some layers are schematic or digitized from maps. Do not assume engineering-grade route geometry.

Source / product: Gridfinder / ESMAP — Derived global electricity network
Location / asset content: Predicted distribution/transmission lines; original OSM lines identified in source field; contextual rasters.
Access / format: GeoPackage, GeoTIFF and feature service.
License / permission: Catalog states CC BY 4.0; retain upstream provenance.
Vintage / update notes: Release year 2020; catalog metadata updated August 2025.
Main limitation: Predicted network, not a verified asset register. Keep separate from observed line geometry.

Location / asset content: 58,502 wastewater treatment plants; population served, effluent and treatment attributes; estimated river outfalls.
Access / format: Download via HydroSHEDS / Figshare; geolocated tabular data.
License / permission: CC BY 4.0.
Vintage / update notes: Version 1; associated publication 2022.
Main limitation: Some attributes are estimated. Plant coordinates and estimated outfall coordinates are different entities; no sewer-pipe network.

Location / asset content: v1: 41,145 barrier locations and 35,295 reservoir polygons; barrier/reservoir attributes.
Access / format: Provider download form; vector datasets.
License / permission: CC BY, as stated by provider.
Vintage / update notes: v1; 2024 associated publication; periodically updated product.
Main limitation: Not a drinking-water treatment inventory. Includes former GOODD and GRanD records; do not append those as new independent assets.

Source / product: Water Point Data Exchange — WPdx-Basic / WPdx+
Location / asset content: Water-point coordinates, technology/source, management and assessment information.
Access / format: Free repository downloads; country CSV. WPdx+ is an enhanced subset for selected countries.
License / permission: CC BY 4.0 provider agreement.
Vintage / update notes: Observation dates vary; not all countries have WPdx+.
Main limitation: Water points are not municipal treatment systems. Keep observed functionality separate from predicted status.

Location / asset content: Health-facility points and attributes sourced through OpenStreetMap.
Access / format: API and documented CSV / GeoJSON / Shapefile exports; country products also on HDX.
License / permission: ODbL for OSM-derived data.
Vintage / update notes: Community updates; check each country export date.
Main limitation: Overlaps OSM rather than providing independent confirmation. Direct main-site fetch failed in this review; HDX/provider documentation found; API not tested.

Sector: Medical; water; sewer; other sectors where available
Source / product: Humanitarian Data Exchange — country infrastructure datasets
Coverage: Global catalog; concentrated in humanitarian settings
Location / asset content: Ministry, NGO and OSM-derived country facility lists and WASH layers.
Access / format: Dataset-specific files and services; inspect actual resource downloads.
License / permission: Dataset-specific; portal footer is not a blanket license for every dataset.
Vintage / update notes: Check resource dates and original observation dates, not only catalog metadata.
Main limitation: Many products republish OSM or other registries. Restricted or stale country datasets must be flagged separately.

Location / asset content: Facility points; related health boundaries and contextual population data.
Access / format: GRID3 Data Hub; country-specific vector downloads.
License / permission: Check individual country-product license and disclosure terms.
Vintage / update notes: Example: DRC page lists Health Facilities v9.0, August 2026.
Main limitation: Not a global inventory. Validation and completeness vary; do not assume all GRID3 products are field-verified.

Source / product: WHO — Geolocated Health Facilities Data initiative
Coverage: Country master-list initiative; intended global directory
Location / asset content: Supports ministry-maintained georeferenced health facility master lists and identifiers.
Access / format: Use country ministry lists where available; no global directory download currently available.
License / permission: Country-specific data-sharing terms; no blanket global license verified.
Vintage / update notes: WHO page explicitly says the global directory is not available yet.
Main limitation: Not a ready-to-ingest worldwide facility file.

Location / asset content: Estimated cellular-cell positions, radio/network identifiers, samples and last-seen timestamps.
Access / format: Country / worldwide CSV and daily change files; API token required.
License / permission: CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and share-alike conditions.
Vintage / update notes: Daily exports; documentation says download records were observed within the last 18 months.
Main limitation: A cell is not a physical tower. Estimated range is not a surveyed location-error radius. Multiple cells can share one site.

Location / asset content: Interconnection facilities, IXPs and network-to-facility presence.
Access / format: API / structured records; authentication and limits depend on use.
License / permission: Restrictive acceptable-use policy; seek approval for proposed bulk compilation / redistribution.
Vintage / update notes: Continuously user-maintained; track record updates.
Main limitation: Free access does not grant unrestricted reuse. Does not describe every data center or complete physical fiber routes.

Location / asset content: Cable routes, landing points, status, ownership and ready-for-service information.
Access / format: Annual data license; JSON API including GeoJSON and JSON.
License / permission: Commercial license for underlying map data; public map access is not a bulk-data license.
Vintage / update notes: Regularly maintained; provider no longer maintains old GitHub data repository.
Main limitation: Map routes/landing points should not be treated as surveyed alignments or verified building footprints.

Location / asset content: Terrestrial fiber and microwave backbone connectivity; research and operator-supplied information.
Access / format: Map and documented OGC WMS; raw-vector bulk access not verified.
License / permission: Confirm permissions with ITU for intended extraction, storage and redistribution.
Vintage / update notes: Ongoing research; inspected service metadata dated May 2025.
Main limitation: WMS access is a map service, not proof that downloadable vector data is offered or licensed.

Location / asset content: Regulated facilities and program identifiers; separate discharge-point / outfall features.
Access / format: National bulk downloads and map / feature services.
License / permission: Public EPA data; review individual service metadata and any third-party restrictions.
Vintage / update notes: Dataset-specific updates; drinking-water system data refreshed quarterly.
Main limitation: Public water-system records are not necessarily individual treatment plants. NPDES also includes industrial dischargers.

Location / asset content: Publicly owned wastewater treatment works, technical attributes and service-area boundaries.
Access / format: CSV / Access via CWNS dashboard; downloadable sewershed GIS data.
License / permission: Public EPA data; retain source metadata.
Vintage / update notes: CWNS describes conditions as of January 1, 2022; separate sewershed product.
Main limitation: Survey snapshot, not live operations. Sewershed boundaries are partly modeled and are not sewer-pipe alignments.

Location / asset content: Treatment-plant locations, discharge points and agglomerations in separate layers.
Access / format: Public GIS downloads and services; formats vary by release.
License / permission: Check dataset-specific EEA reuse conditions; select PUBLIC versions, not restricted internal products.
Vintage / update notes: Use latest public final release; reporting period can predate publication substantially.
Main limitation: Reporting thresholds and geographic coverage apply. Treatment plants, outfalls and agglomeration centroids are not interchangeable.

Coverage: Europe and nearby countries listed in metadata
Location / asset content: Desalination records joined to municipality-centroid points; plant attributes in a related table.
Access / format: Shapefile / geodatabase download; WMS.
License / permission: CC BY 4.0.
Vintage / update notes: Inspected file revision August 2021; metadata timestamp August 2025.
Main limitation: Generally municipality centroids, with some coarser fallbacks; NOT reliable plant-site coordinates. One location may relate to multiple plants.

Location / asset content: Plant/project database and market information.
Access / format: Subscription / sales-assisted access; request a sample and export specification.
License / permission: Proprietary; negotiate storage, export and redistribution rights.
Vintage / update notes: Maintained commercial product; contracted extract vintage must be specified.
Main limitation: Exact plant-coordinate availability and accuracy were NOT verified. Confirm before purchasing; not all municipal water infrastructure.

Location / asset content: Registered antenna-structure coordinates and structure characteristics.
Access / format: ASR public-access database files; documentation and search.
License / permission: Public FCC records; review applicable reuse terms and metadata.
Vintage / update notes: Use a dated full extract and available updates.
Main limitation: ASR is not an inventory of all mobile cells, rooftop antennas or small cells. Registration/status does not establish current service.

Source / product: US EIA — EIA-860 / US Energy Atlas
Location / asset content: Plant/generator inventory and geographic power-generation layers.
Access / format: Annual EIA-860 bulk files; Energy Atlas GIS downloads.
License / permission: Public EIA data; verify licenses of third-party Atlas layers separately.
Vintage / update notes: Use the latest released survey year and distinguish it from website update date.
Main limitation: Generator and plant records require separate IDs. Do not assume an old Atlas/HIFLD transmission link remains a maintained source.

Location / asset content: Hospital identifiers, names, addresses, hospital type and other attributes.
Access / format: Provider Data Catalog download / API.
License / permission: Public CMS data; check dataset terms.
Vintage / update notes: Dataset page reviewed is dated July 22, 2026.
Main limitation: Not every healthcare facility. Addresses may require licensed geocoding or a documented match to an existing spatial source.

Location / asset content: Infrastructure-oriented rendering of OpenStreetMap.
Access / format: Interactive map; extract underlying OSM data rather than treating map tiles as an asset feed.
License / permission: Underlying OSM data: ODbL; inspect map-specific terms.
Vintage / update notes: Use to inspect mapping coverage; no independently verified asset inventory.
Main limitation: Not an independent dataset and not a second source of confirmation.

Location / asset content: Historical multi-sector infrastructure layers; contents vary by archive.
Access / format: Use original producing agencies where available; archived snapshots for historical reference.
License / permission: Layer-specific licenses; do not assume all HIFLD products are public domain.
Vintage / update notes: FGDC confirms HIFLD Open decommissioned; subcommittee retired March 2026.
Main limitation: Do not build a live-ingestion dependency on the former HIFLD Open portal. Archives are not current feeds.
